name: Fairmont El San Juan Hotel
positioning: Fairmont El San Juan Hotel, a beachfront resort hotel in Isla Verde, San Juan, that first opened in 1958
best_for: Beach lovers who want to be close to the airport
Guests who enjoy lively evenings, with bars, a casino and live entertainment on site

facts.text: The hotel first opened in 1958 and had a nightclub that drew legends such as Frank Sinatra and Liza Minnelli.
Designer Jeffrey Beers led a renovation, unveiled in December 2018, that modernized the common spaces, restaurants and bars while preserving the property's history.
Rooms in the Grand Tower have ocean, pool or city views and a sitting area.
Villa rooms are centered around a pool, with outdoor space, large bathrooms and complimentary breakfast.
Guests can choose among lounges, daybeds or luxury cabanas spread among the four pools.
Besides the Chandelier Bar, the hotel has a rum bar, a wine bar, a cabaret bar and a café specializing in local coffee.
The Well & Being Spa has a fitness center with an outdoor rooftop, with classes from vertical wall yoga to water-focused workouts to indoor cycling.
The hotel offers water sports such as kayaking and parasailing, and has a tennis center onsite.
The hotel is very close to the airport, with about 10 minutes from baggage claim to the beach.
The hotel is in Isla Verde, a short taxi ride from Piñones, where food lovers go kiosk-hopping.

highlights.text: The lobby has a glistening oval chandelier at its center, described as the third largest of its kind in the world.
The Banyan Bungalow is named for the hotel's 300-year-old tree and has a terrace with garden and pool views.
Dining includes the poolside Caña by chef Jose Enrique Montes, a branch of the Miami steakhouse Meat Market, and a 12-seat sushi speakeasy called Sushi By Bou.
Nightlife includes Chico Cabaret, a speakeasy with live entertainment, and Club Brava, a bi-level dance club.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says more walkable attractions would be nice.
Wi-Fi is part of the resort fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
